top3.headline: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
top3.whyItMatters: An Apple agent would reach staff and customers on devices they already use every day.

top3.headline: Builders warm to Gemini 4 Neon but want open harness access
top3.whyItMatters: Google's gap is now access, not quality, which could shift which models teams pick.

top3.headline: Simon Willison warns token fraud is here and it's bad
top3.whyItMatters: Teams paying per token should check who can spend on their AI keys and accounts.

items.title: Stratechery's Sharp Tech: 'Jensen's Not Coming Back'
items.takeaway: Ben Thompson's Sharp Tech on Video episode covers Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia, AI shopping and the iPhone Duo.
items.soWhat: A week on, Nvidia's leadership change is still the story analysts keep returning to.

items.title: Tibo: SEO works again when you track AI visibility
items.takeaway: Tibo says SEO worked 'insanely well' for his products in the past 2 months: buying listicle spots, monitoring AI visibility, long-tail keywords and questions.
items.soWhat: Being cited by AI assistants is becoming part of how products get found.

items.title: T3 Code's latest stable release improves Gemini support
items.takeaway: Theo says the newest stable T3 Code release should be a significant improvement in Antigravity and Gemini support.
items.soWhat: Coding tools are racing to support Gemini well, which widens model choice for teams.

items.title: Geoffrey Huntley runs one bot per virtual employee
items.takeaway: Huntley describes showing his builder how he manages work through his bots, creating one bot per virtual employee.
items.soWhat: Giving each agent one job role is a simple pattern any team can try.

items.title: GAO test bypassed safeguards on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok
items.takeaway: X News reports a GAO test posing as regular users got past the chatbots' safeguards with common techniques; two outlined improvised explosives.
items.soWhat: Treat vendor guardrails as one layer and add your own controls for staff and agents.

image.alt: X News: GAO test bypassed safeguards on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok

items.title: Meng To: Astra 6.2 reaches new 3D realism with extra steering
items.takeaway: Meng To says that with extra steering, Astra 6.2 reaches 3D realism he has not seen from a model before, and links his full workflow.
items.soWhat: Guided well, lower-cost models can now produce high-end 3D visuals.

items.title: Builders warm to Gemini 4 Neon but want open harness access
items.takeaway: kunchenguid calls Neon 'not bad' and says Google only needs to allow Gemini subscriptions in any harness. Theo calls it the first Gemini worth a functioning platform.
items.soWhat: Google's gap is shifting from model quality to how developers can access it.

items.title: Simon Willison warns token fraud is here and it's bad
items.takeaway: Simon Willison shared a video talk on his blog titled 'Token fraud is here and it's BAD'.
items.soWhat: If you pay for AI by the token, check who can spend on your keys and accounts.

image.alt: Simon Willison: Simon Willison warns token fraud is here and it's bad

items.title: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
items.takeaway: A job listing reported by The Verge shows Apple recruiting engineers to build an AI agent of its own.
items.soWhat: An Apple agent would reach staff and customers on devices they already use.

items.title: Meta's Muse Charm might cost $300, The Verge reports
items.takeaway: The Verge reports Meta's Muse Charm AI device might be priced at $300.
items.soWhat: Price will decide whether AI wearables spread beyond early adopters.

items.title: Stratechery interviews Eric Seufert on agentic commerce
items.takeaway: Ben Thompson interviewed Eric Seufert about agentic commerce, where AI agents shop on people's behalf.
items.soWhat: If agents do the shopping, how brands get chosen and paid will change.

hotOnX.text: Gemini 4 Neon is not bad; Google only needs to allow Gemini subscriptions in any harness for a comeback.
hotOnX.note: Developers want to use Gemini plans inside the coding tools they already prefer.

hotOnX.text: Neon is the first Gemini model good enough to deserve a functioning platform.
hotOnX.note: A well-known Gemini critic now praises the model while still pushing Google on its platform.

hotOnX.text: The latest stable release of T3 Code should be a significant improvement in Antigravity/Gemini support.
hotOnX.note: Tool makers are moving fast to support Neon.

hotOnX.text: Showing how he manages work through his bots, with one bot per virtual employee.
hotOnX.note: A concrete picture of running a small company with agents in job roles.

hotOnX.text: SEO has worked insanely well again in the past 2 months: listicles, AI visibility, long-tail keywords, questions.
hotOnX.note: Founders are curious how to get found by AI assistants, not just search engines.
